text: Ko gomɗinɗo on tijjinoo kon halkuyee=halkaare huuɓiti dimɗe ngesa keefeero on,keefeero on wattini himo waylita newe makko ɗen ka sattude suno e nimse e dow ko o rokki kon jawle fii dankagol mba e moƴƴinngol mba, ngesa mban ko yanumba e hoore tugaale mun, ɗen ɗe calɗi inabuuje ɗen layi hoore mun,himo wi'a: "Ee jalla wonno min,mi gomɗinno Joomi an Kanko Tun, hara mi kafidaano e Makko hay e gooto e jeyaaɓe ɓen.
